description: Qubo launched the Dashcam Pro 2K (Front + Rear) in India at its Qubo Connected World 2026 event on Tuesday. It is positioned as an affordable dual-channel dashcam solution that can record in 2K resolution using the front camera and 1080p using the rear camera. The dashcam also offers features like G-Sensor-based collision detection, Wi-Fi connectivity, and a Supercapacitor. Alongside the new dashcam, the Hero Group-backed company also outlined its upcoming roadmap, centred around its proprietary AI Guard technology.
title: Qubo Dashcam Pro 2K With Front, Rear Cameras Launched in India; Company Showcases AI Smart Home Portfolio

description: Apple and Broadcom have agreed to extend their partnership till 2031, the US-based chipmaker revealed in an 8K regulatory filing submitted to the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Monday. The renewed multi-year agreements between the two US-based tech giants include the development and supply of custom application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) silicon chips. The chipmaker says that Apple will use these chips in future generations of devices. Broadcom has been supplying RF chips and networking modules to Apple for its devices for years now. These chips enable multiple wireless connectivity features for Apple devices. Moreover, Apple’s custom C1 and C1X modems also comprise a few components, which are supplied by Broadcom.
title: Apple and Broadcom Agree to Extend Chip Supply Partnership Till 2031, Regulatory Filing Reveals

description: Google app for Android version 17.38.5.sa.arm64 has a new setting option for Gemini Live. It will reportedly get a new toggle for Guided Vision in Live. This feature is not live yet. The new option could prevent Gemini Live from accessing the camera. Enabling the feature will let  Gemini Live use the phone's camera to analyse objects in real time during conversations.
title: Google Is Reportedly Working on an Option to Disable Gemini Live's Guided Vision Feature

description: The upcoming iPhone Air 2 is now tipped to address the shortcomings of the iPhone Air. The new model is said to come with a larger battery and a dual rear camera system, marking a notable upgrade over its predecessor. It is likely to launch in the spring of next year. It is said to feature an A20 chip built based on the 2nm process. The iPhone Air 2 may include a 6.55-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate. The phone is said to support 3D face recognition.
title: iPhone Air 2 Tipped to Feature Bigger Battery, Dual Rear Cameras

description: BonkDAO has disclosed that attackers stole $20 million worth of BONK tokens after exploiting what it described as a malicious governance proposal. The decentralised autonomous organisation said it has reported the incident to law enforcement and is working to recover the stolen funds while identifying those responsible. The exploit comes as crypto protocols continue to face a surge in security breaches during one of the industry’s most active periods for hacks.
title: BonkDAO Suffers $20 Million Loss Through Malicious Governance Proposal

description: A LinkedIn teaser shared by Qualcomm Korea President Spencer Kim hints at another Snapdragon-powered Samsung Galaxy device. The video features a Snapdragon 8 Elite For Galaxy chip on a stylised circuit board before ending with Samsung branding and the message "Power up with Snapdragon". The teaser does not identify the product or reveal hardware details. It comes amid reports that Qualcomm is preparing Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and Gen 6 Pro chipsets, although the company has not confirmed those specifications.
title: Qualcomm Executive Teases Snapdragon Chip for Upcoming Samsung Galaxy Devices

description: Nothing has unveiled the Ear (3a) true wireless earphones alongside the Nothing Phone 4b in global markets. The earbuds feature a 12mm dynamic driver, Adaptive ANC with up to 45dB noise reduction, Bluetooth 6.0 and LDAC support. They also introduce Audio Snapshot for recording short audio clips through gesture controls. Nothing claims up to 42 hours of total playback with the charging case. The earbuds are currently available in select global markets, while India pricing and launch details remain unconfirmed.
title: Nothing Ear (3a) Launched With 45dB ANC, 'Audio Snapshot' and Call Recording Support: Price, Features

description: Nothing Phone (4b) is the latest addition in the company's smartphone portfolio in India. On paper, the Phone (4b) gets bells and whistles, including design elements from its elder siblings, like the unibody design from the Phone (4a) Pro and the Glyph Bar from the Phone (4a). The Phone (4b) also has the biggest battery on any Nothing phone. Additionally, Nothing hasn't skipped adding the Essential AI tools accessible through the Essential Key. Here are our first impressions.
title: Nothing Phone (4b) First Impressions

description: Ripple has secured full authorisation under the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework after receiving a Crypto Asset Service Provider (CASP) licence from Luxembourg’s financial regulator. The approval allows the company to provide crypto services across the European Economic Area through passporting. The milestone comes after the EU’s MiCA transition period ended, requiring crypto firms to obtain authorisation or cease operations in the bloc.
title: Ripple Receives Full MiCA Approval in Luxembourg for Crypto Asset Services in Europe

description: Honor's first wide foldable smartphone is reportedly progressing through development, with a new leak revealing additional hardware details. The prototype is tipped to retain a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.5-inch cover screen while featuring a 200-megapixel camera, a periscope telephoto camera and a battery exceeding 7,000mAh. Earlier reports also suggested a 2nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series chipset. The handset is expected to compete with Huawei's Pura X Max, although Honor has not confirmed the device.
title: Honor Wide Foldable Leak Offers Details About Its Display, Camera and Battery

description: A mysterious Redmi smartphone has appeared on Singapore's IMDA certification website with the model number 2607FRNEAG. The phone is listed under the Redmi brand, and the listing suggests a few connectivity options. Since the model number has now surfaced on a regulatory platform, we can expect it to go official soon. Additional certifications and leaks are expected to reveal its name and features in the coming weeks.
title: Mysterious Redmi Smartphone Bags IMDA Certification, Hinting at Upcoming Launch

description: Nothing Phone 4b has been launched in India. Apart from the standard edition, the Nothing Phone 4b RCB Edition is currently available in India via the limited drop event at the Nothing Store in Bengaluru. The new Phone 4b will go on sale in the country on July 14 via Flipkart and select offline retailers. The handset is offered in Black, Blue, and White colour options. The Nothing Phone 4b is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 6 Gen 4 chipset, coupled with a 6,000mAh battery. The handset carries a dual rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel main shooter.
title: Nothing Phone 4b Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, Glyph Bar Interface, Phone 4b RCB Edition Tags Along

description: Microsoft is rolling out AI-powered meeting tools, new chat organisation options, and improvements to guest invitations for Teams. Among the notable features is an AI Facilitator, which is claimed to be capable of identifying knowledge gaps during meetings. Other features include AI-generated notes and dedicated sections for muted and meeting chat. The update has reportedly surfaced through Microsoft's admin portal, while the wider rollout is expected to happen in the coming weeks.
title: Microsoft Teams Updated With AI Facilitator for In-Person Meetings, New Chat Features: Report

description: Vivo has begun teasing the T5 Lite 5G ahead of its India launch and confirmed that the smartphone will feature a 6,500mAh battery with 44W FlashCharge support. A Flipkart microsite is now live, confirming the handset's online availability and OriginOS 6 support based on Android 16. Leaks suggest it could use a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 or Dimensity 6400 chipset, alongside a 120Hz display, a 50-megapixel rear camera, and up to 256GB of storage.
title: Vivo T5 Lite 5G India Debut Teased; Battery and Charging Details Confirmed

description: Motorola Edge 70 Max will be launched in India soon, the company revealed on Tuesday. A dedicated microsite for the upcoming smartphone is now live on Flipkart, confirming that the Motorola Edge 70 Max will go on sale in the country via the e-commerce platform. The microsite suggests that the handset will be equipped with a triple rear camera unit and an LED flash, housed inside a square-shaped camera module. It will sport a flat rear panel, along with a flat display, unlike the Motorola Edge 70 Pro and Pro+ models. Leaks suggest that the phone will be powered by a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Max India Launch Confirmed; Design, Performance Improvements Teased

description: Redmi Turbo 6 Max is said to be in the works. It is expected to launch in January next year. It is said to come with a 7-inch flat display with 2K resolution. It is tipped to run on a MediaTek Dimensity 9000 series chipset. It is said to come with upgrades over the Redmi Turbo 5 Max. The latter was released in January last year with a starting price tag of CNY 2,499 (roughly Rs. 33,000).
title: Redmi Turbo 6 Max Tipped to Launch in January With 7-Inch 2K Display

description: iQOO Z11 Lite will be launched in India soon, the Vivo sub-brand confirmed on Tuesday. The company had recently started teasing the launch of a new Z series smartphone, which was earlier believed to be the standard iQOO Z11 model. A dedicated microsite for the upcoming smartphone has also been made live in India, confirming that the iQOO Z11 Lite will go on sale in the country via Amazon. In terms of design, the iQOO Z11 Lite is shown to sport a flat rear panel, featuring a pill-shaped camera module in the top-left corner. The handset is also shown to feature an LED flash and a ring light.
title: iQOO Z11 Lite India Launch Teased as Firm Reveals Design, Availability Details

description: Bitcoin traded above $63,000 on Tuesday after recovering from selling triggered by Strategy’s BTC sale. Analysts said stronger buying demand, easing sell pressure, and a weaker US dollar supported the recovery. At the same time, investors remain focused on upcoming US inflation data and the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook.
title: Crypto Investors Help BTC Stabilise Above $63,000 After Brief Volatility Following Strategy's Bitcoin Sale

description: Nintendo on Monday announced that it will begin rolling out revised versions of the Nintendo Switch 2 console and several accessories in Europe with user-replaceable batteries. The Japanese video game company will introduce its updated hardware in phases, beginning this summer. The move comes ahead of the new battery regulations issued by the European Union (EU), which are set to take effect in February 2027. Despite minor changes in battery capacities, Nintendo says there will be no functional differences between the current and refreshed models.
title: Nintendo Switch 2, Joy-Cons to Get User-Replaceable Batteries in Europe Ahead of New EU Rules

description: Samsung Galaxy A08, Galaxy F08 and Galaxy M08 have reportedly appeared on the BIS website. The Galaxy A08 is reportedly listed with model number SM-A085F/DS, while the Galaxy F08 is listed as SM-E085F/DS. The Galaxy M08 appeared bearing model number SM-M085F/DS. They are expected to come with dual SIM connectivity. Samsung has yet to announce an official launch timeline for the devices.
title: Samsung Galaxy A08, Galaxy F08 and Galaxy M08 Visit BIS Database, India Debut Could Be on the Cards

description: A fresh leak suggests Samsung could market its upcoming clip-on earbuds as the Galaxy Buds On instead of Galaxy Buds Able. The audio device is associated with the SM-U600 model number, which differs from previous Galaxy Buds models. Earlier leaks pointed to an open-ear clip-on design and possible bone conduction technology. References to Galaxy Able have also surfaced in the Galaxy Wearable app and BIS certification. The earbuds are expected to launch later this year, possibly alongside the Galaxy S26 FE.
title: Samsung's Upcoming Clip-On Earbuds Could Debut as the Galaxy Buds On, Tipster Claims

description: Apple started rolling out the latest iOS 27 beta 3 update on Monday. According to a report, the latest beta version of iOS 27 adds “Pace” and “Expressivity” customisations for Siri’s voice. The adjustments will purportedly tweak how the voice assistant responds. The customisations might also affect how the assistant responds within Maps and Safari. These Siri Voice customisations were reportedly earlier labelled as “Coming Soon”. As the names suggest, the “Pace” slider controls the speed at which Siri narrates answers, while the “Expressivity” slider lets users tweak the tone of the answers. It is said to be similar to OpenAI’s voice customisations for ChatGPT.
title: iOS 27 Beta 3: Apple Lets Beta Testers Customise Siri Voice ‘Pace’ and ‘Expressivity’ Weeks After WWDC 2026

description: iQOO's next flagship smartphone has been at the centre of several leaks in recent weeks. While the rumour mill previously suggested that the purported handset could make its way to India after debuting in its home market of China, a fresh claim indicates otherwise. According to a tipster, the iQOO 16 may not launch in India this year due to rising costs of memory components. The company is also said to have scaled back its roadmap for India.
title: iQOO 16 May Not Launch in India as Rising Component Prices Impact Plans; Only One Z-Series Phone Tipped

description: Vivo X300e has received China's 3C certification with model number V2612A. The listing indicates that the phone supports 90W fast charging. The Vivo X300e is rumoured to come with a 6.59-inch OLED flat screen with 1.5K resolution. It could run on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and feature a Zeiss-branded triple camera unit including a 50-megapixel primary sensor.
title: Vivo X300e Reportedly Bags 3C Certification, Charging Details Revealed

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro will be equipped with an Exynos 2700 chipset in South Korea and the EU, according to a report citing industry sources. However, in the US, the handset will reportedly be powered by an unspecified Snapdragon chip from Qualcomm. This comes soon after Samsung's President of System LSI Business, Park Yong-In, seemingly confirmed that the tech giant has started the development of its next-generation mobile chipset, namely Exynos 2700, which will succeed the Exynos 2600 chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro Won't Feature the Same Chipset as the Ultra Model in Some Markets: Report

description: iQOO has teased the arrival of a new Z11 series smartphone in India, which is widely expected to be the iQOO Z11. While the global variants use the Dimensity 8500 and Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipsets, a Geekbench AI listing suggests the Indian model could feature the Dimensity 7500 with 12GB RAM and Android 16. The handset may launch later this month and could be based on the Vivo S60e, according to recent reports and benchmark listings.
title: iQOO Z11 Could Launch in India Soon as Company Teases Arrival of New Z Series Model

description: With the launch of the iPhone 18 series anticipated for September, leaks have been providing us with a glimpse of what to expect. The lineup, which is primarily expected to comprise the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, has now surfaced in a regulatory filing in China. The listing, shared by a tipster, appears to reveal the battery capacities of the purported iPhone models. The certification also indicates regional battery differences between the US and international models of the iPhone 18 lineup.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Battery Capacities Leaked as Handsets Surface on 3C Certification Database

description: Microsoft announced sweeping restructuring of its Xbox gaming division on Tuesday. As part of what is described as the biggest reset in Xbox's history, the company is laying off approximately 3,200 employees and spinning off four game development studios. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said the restructuring is aimed at simplifying operations, reducing costs, and returning the business to growth by 2027. The changes come amidst sluggish growth in the core Xbox business, weaker Game Pass adoption, and mounting pressure on the gaming industry.
title: Xbox Announces 3,200 Layoffs, Four Studio Divestments Through 2027; Plans Biggest Restructure in Its History
